biotools.summary: PangenePro is an automated pipeline for rapid identification and classification of gene family members across multiple plant genomes, integrating sequence alignment, domain validation, and orthologous clustering. The pipeline is freely available on GitHub and facilitates intraspecific genetic diversity studies.
